notes: `gate=true` means CI fails if the measured value exceeds the matching target.
Each metric has a single `target` (or `target_min` when `comparison=ge`). Per-backend maps were dropped when the in-memory backend was removed.
Comparison defaults to `le` (lower is better). `comparison=ge` flips to lower-bound.

metrics.label: Cold start to bound listener
metrics.how: process spawn -> `--self-test-ready` exits cleanly; median of 5 runs

metrics.label: Idle RSS (5 s after start, no traffic)
metrics.how: max of 3 samples 1 s apart, read from `/proc/<pid>/status` VmRSS

metrics.label: Wipe-restart (kill nanostack, then back up)
metrics.how: kill running instance, respawn with same args, time to first TCP accept; median of 5. fs has to walk objects/* to rebuild the key index on each spawn.

metrics.label: Warm p50 PutObject (1 KB body)
metrics.how: 10k sequential PutObject ops via aws-sdk-go-v2. Target reflects the cost of two atomic writes (data + meta.json) with fsync.

metrics.label: Warm p99 GetObject (≤ 1 MB)
metrics.how: 10k sequential GetObject ops against a freshly-PUT 1 KB key

metrics.label: Concurrent PutObject 1 KB throughput
metrics.how: 32 concurrent goroutines over 5 s via aws-sdk-go-v2; unique keys per worker. PRD's original 50k req/s target assumed wrk/bombardier against raw HTTP (no per-request SigV4); SDK-driven measurement reflects what users actually see.

metrics.label: Multipart upload p99 (5 parts × 5 MiB, concurrent)
metrics.how: 20 iterations of {InitiateMPU → 5 concurrent UploadParts of 5 MiB each → CompleteMPU}, p99 of total wall time per iteration. Target is ~3× the locally-measured baseline; CI runners typically have slower disks than dev machines.

informational_metrics.label: Warm p50 HeadBucket
informational_metrics.how: 10k sequential HeadBucket ops via aws-sdk-go-v2, 50th percentile

informational_metrics.label: Multipart upload p50 (5 parts × 5 MiB, concurrent)
